name: Haolin He
intro: I'm a Ph.D. student at [The Chinese University of Hong Kong](https://www.cuhk.edu.hk/), advised by [Prof. Qiuqiang Kong](https://qiuqiangkong.github.io/), and a research intern with the Qwen team at Alibaba.
Previously, I was a research intern with the Venus team at Ant Group. I received my B.Eng. in Communication Engineering from the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China in 2024.
I work on multimodal understanding and interaction, aiming to build AI assistants that understand people's needs, interact naturally, and integrate deeply into their everyday lives.
